welcomeLetter.title: Welcome Letter
welcomeLetter.intro: Congratulations on your decision and Welcome to {{company}}. Your entrepreneurial spirit will now enable you to take part in a wonderful business opportunity, which will secure a bright future for you and your family. We are here to lead, guide and accompany you side by side, towards our world of success. Each of us will play a role to ensure your successful integration into the company.
welcomeLetter.note1: One PAN One ID. Associate must visit office once in week.
welcomeLetter.note2: Two Sponsor must till Gold. Diamond associate must sale 1 Plot every year.
welcomeLetter.note3: Direct Income can be refund in case of cancellation of any plot.
welcomeLetter.note4: Associate may be punished in case of spreading rumors against company.
welcomeLetter.note5: 10% Extra Incentive will be given in case of collection EMI from recovery team.
welcomeLetter.note6: These all plan for those associates who works for only {{company}}.
welcomeLetter.note7: Only associates are responsible for giving plan to their customers. Legal action will be taken in case of interference of company work.
welcomeLetter.note8: TDS (5%) (As per Government rule.). Admin Charge also 5% will be applicable.
welcomeLetter.note9: Must attend company organized meeting for rewards. Example Seminar, Convention, Weekly Training Meeting.
welcomeLetter.signoff: ALL THE BEST, SEE YOU AT TOP !!
